unit:
[Unit]
Description=Apply a staged Lyra OS release upgrade
Documentation=https://github.com/lyra-os-linux/lyraos-desktop-updater
DefaultDependencies=no
ConditionPathIsSymbolicLink=/system-update
After=local-fs.target
Before=system-update.target shutdown.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
PrivateNetwork=yes
ExecStart=/usr/libexec/lyra-upgrade-offline --reboot
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
TimeoutStartSec=infinity

[Install]
WantedBy=system-update.target
